findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plate_lookup, violation_dismissal_rates · Private data: operator_route_lookup, deadline_calculator, popla_outcomes, violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, search_mtd_answers · Public sink: violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plate_lookup, violation_dismissal_rates · Private data: operator_route_lookup, deadline_calculator, popla_outcomes, violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds, search_mtd_answers · Public sink: violation_dismissal_rates, borough_odds

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
